sourceAuthority: Current GSA 220-1201 objective map validated against the official objective coverage encoded by tools/validate-aplus-core1-field-manual.js

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Mobile accessories: USB-C dock, wireless display adapter, and external keyboard
pbqMapping.evidence: All three required choices are mobile-device accessory or connectivity solutions.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Backlight, digitizer, and display-panel symptom recognition
pbqMapping.evidence: Each task identifies a display component from a component-specific symptom.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: LAN switching, site-to-site VPN tunneling, and wireless access
pbqMapping.evidence: VPN is a network configuration concept; switch and access point are networking hardware devices.
pbqMapping.correction: Objective metadata changed from 2.1-2.2 to 2.4 and 2.5.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Copper, PoE, and fiber media selection
pbqMapping.evidence: All tasks select cable media or cable features for a stated installation.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS recognition
pbqMapping.evidence: Provider/customer responsibility clues correctly distinguish the three cloud service models.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Safe laptop hardware replacement workflow
pbqMapping.evidence: The sequence covers diagnosis, power isolation, ESD-controlled replacement, testing, and documentation within reasonable service prerequisites.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: External mobile-device controls, ports, speakers, and wireless charging
pbqMapping.evidence: The visual labels identify accessory and connectivity features of a mobile device.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: HTTPS, SSH, and DNS protocol/port recognition
pbqMapping.evidence: Every scored field maps a named protocol to its transport and well-known port.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Bluetooth LE, NFC, and Wi-Fi selection
pbqMapping.evidence: Range, power, proximity, and frequency clues distinguish current wireless technologies.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: SODIMM memory, NVMe M.2 storage, and CMOS battery
pbqMapping.evidence: The three upgrade requirements map to RAM, storage, and motherboard components.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Motherboard CPU socket, DIMM slots, PCIe slot, and ATX power connector
pbqMapping.evidence: All visual callouts are motherboard components and connections.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: RTC battery, RAM, and CPU cooling fault isolation
pbqMapping.evidence: Each symptom maps to the correct motherboard, memory, CPU, or power subsystem.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Network-printer troubleshooting workflow
pbqMapping.evidence: The ordered steps diagnose, correct, verify, and document a printer failure.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Static IPv4 address, subnet mask, and default gateway configuration
pbqMapping.evidence: Every scored field is a basic SOHO endpoint addressing value.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: RAID 0, RAID 1, and NVMe storage selection
pbqMapping.evidence: The tasks compare storage devices and RAID configurations rather than diagnose a failed array.
pbqMapping.correction: Objective metadata changed from 3.3 and 5.2 to 3.4.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Chassis fans, CPU heat sink, and power supply identification
pbqMapping.evidence: The visual callouts identify cooling components and the PSU; no troubleshooting outcome is scored.
pbqMapping.correction: Objective metadata changed from 3.4 and 5.1 to 3.5-3.6.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Virtual compute, storage, and networking resource assignment
pbqMapping.evidence: Each task classifies a virtual machine requirement into its virtualization resource category.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Projector geometry, display cabling, and refresh synchronization troubleshooting
pbqMapping.evidence: All three symptoms are video, projector, or display issues with appropriate corrections.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Network-connectivity troubleshooting sequence
pbqMapping.evidence: The sequence verifies scope, inspects link/addressing, applies a tested correction, and validates access.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: HDMI, DisplayPort, and VGA connector/signal selection
pbqMapping.evidence: Every scored field concerns a display cable, signal type, and compatible destination.
pbqMapping.correction: Objective metadata changed from 3.1 and 3.6 to 3.2.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: UPS, surge protection, and PCIe power connection
pbqMapping.evidence: The primary skill is selecting appropriate power-delivery or protection hardware; UPS and surge recognition are reasonable A+ power prerequisites.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Laser printer imaging drum, toner, transfer roller, and fuser
pbqMapping.evidence: The visual identifies deployable laser components also encountered during printer maintenance.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Storage, wireless-network, and printer failure-domain recognition
pbqMapping.evidence: The three scenarios specifically test drive, network, and printer troubleshooting domains.
pbqMapping.correction: Objective metadata narrowed from 5.1-5.6 to 5.2, 5.5, and 5.6.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Workstation network adapter, memory, and storage selection
pbqMapping.evidence: All scored fields select networking hardware, RAM, or storage; virtualization is not scored.
pbqMapping.correction: Objective metadata changed from 2.4, 3.3, and 4.1 to 2.5, 3.3, and 3.4.

pbqMapping.testedConcept: Integrated power, startup, and network troubleshooting workflow
pbqMapping.evidence: The ordered recovery actions isolate and validate the hardware and connectivity failures named in the scenario.
pbqMapping.correction: Objective metadata narrowed from 5.1-5.5 to 5.1 and 5.5.
